title: Hearing test (audiometry)
what: You wear headphones, listen to quiet sounds of different pitches, and give a sign when you hear them. This makes a chart of your hearing.
why: For hearing loss, noise or ringing in the ears, before fitting a hearing aid, or for work checkups if you work in noise.
tell_doctor: If you recently had a cold, an ear infection, or a blocked ear
If you have earwax buildup or had ear surgery

prepare.title: Quiet
prepare.text: For 24 hours before the test, avoid loud music and noise. Your hearing can drop for a while.

prepare.title: Ears
prepare.text: Do not push cotton swabs deep into your ears. If there is a wax plug, the doctor will remove it first.

bring: Past audiograms, if you have them
Your hearing aid, if you wear one
steps: The doctor looks in your ears
You sit in a quiet booth and put on headphones
Quiet beeps play, in one ear and then the other
When you hear one, you press a button or raise your hand
Sometimes a small vibrating device is put behind your ear and the test is repeated
Sometimes you are asked to repeat words
feel: The quietest sounds are barely heard. Answer even if you are not sure
after: The result is a hearing chart, usually given right away
An ENT doctor will explain what it means
red_flags: Hearing suddenly lost in one ear over hours or a day: see a doctor the same day

faq.q: Can I check my hearing online?
faq.a: An online test gives only a rough idea. Audiometry in a quiet booth gives the exact picture.

faq.q: Why is sudden hearing loss urgent?
faq.a: Treatment works better if it starts in the first days. Do not wait for it to pass on its own.

reminders.text: Hearing test tomorrow. Today, no loud music and no headphones at full volume.
